title: BitGo Acquires NYDIG’s Institutional Trading Business, Expanding Its Institutional Markets Platform
summary: The acquisition expands BitGo’s institutional markets platform, with enhanced derivatives and financing capabilities that strengthen its existing trading offerings.
body_markdown:
## Key Takeaways


-


BitGo has acquired NYDIG’s institutional trading business and related assets.


-


The acquisition expands BitGo’s institutional markets platform, with enhanced derivatives and financing capabilities that strengthen its existing trading offerings.


-


NYDIG’s institutional trading business brings execution experience with derivatives and financing capabilities that complement BitGo’s digital asset infrastructure.


-


Clients gain access to a broader range of trading and capital markets services through BitGo’s integrated platform.


BitGo has acquired NYDIG’s institutional trading business and related assets, expanding our institutional markets platform and strengthening our ability to serve sophisticated clients globally. Product availability is subject to jurisdiction, client eligibility, applicable regulatory requirements, onboarding, and the terms of the relevant BitGo entity.


The acquisition is expected to enhance BitGo’s financing capabilities and derivatives, strengthening our existing trading offerings while complementing our regulated custody, settlement, and wallet infrastructure. For clients, that means access to a broader range of trading and capital markets services through BitGo’s integrated platform.


## More for BitGo Clients


NYDIG’s institutional trading business expands the capabilities available through BitGo’s existing platform, particularly across derivatives and financing. Clients can access these capabilities alongside BitGo’s existing trading, custody, settlement, and wallet infrastructure.


Bringing the businesses together creates a more integrated experience for clients and efficiencies across technology, operations, and compliance. It also strengthens BitGo’s ability to serve a broader base of sophisticated clients that can benefit from our comprehensive infrastructure offerings.


The acquisition brings NYDIG’s institutional client relationships to BitGo. NYDIG’s institutional trading clients gain access to the scale and breadth of capability available through BitGo’s comprehensive digital asset infrastructure platform.


## Expanding BitGo’s Institutional Markets Capabilities


NYDIG’s institutional trading business provides derivatives, structured products, financing, and capital markets solutions to a sophisticated client base. Its team has built longstanding expertise working with asset managers, hedge funds, corporates, family offices, and other market participants that demand access to liquidity, tailored risk management, and customized trading strategies.


Approximately 30 NYDIG employees have joined BitGo as part of the acquisition. The team brings execution experience with derivatives and financing capabilities that are complementary to BitGo’s digital asset infrastructure.


Bringing this experienced team and client franchise to BitGo expands our institutional markets platform and strengthens our ability to serve sophisticated clients globally.


## Strengthening BitGo’s Integrated Platform


BitGo has built a comprehensive digital asset infrastructure platform spanning custody, wallets, staking, trading, financing, stablecoins, and settlement. The addition of NYDIG’s institutional trading business strengthens the institutional markets capabilities within that existing platform.


The transaction further strengthens BitGo’s position as a comprehensive digital asset infrastructure company. Clients can access a broader range of trading and capital markets services through an integrated platform designed to support the full lifecycle of digital assets.


By bringing BitGo’s existing infrastructure together with NYDIG’s institutional trading expertise, the acquisition expands what BitGo can offer clients while strengthening the ability to serve a broader base of sophisticated market participants.
